name: Pennant
feature_notes: Admiral Office and Fleet Watchtower open with an account button. Users can choose to remember a verified Admiral email on this device.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: After the passage PIN, check the account chooser on your iPad. Choose an Admiral email, sign in, and test the optional remembered address on your next fresh sign-in.
